doc: Dialogue voices (M3-AUD-07; SPEC §16 Q4: no voice acting yet, but ready for it; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md "Voices"). VoiceAudio (game/audio/voice_audio.gd) listens to each DialogueBox and plays the speaker's blips in place of the box's one shared blip. speakers: a speakers.json id (every one needs a row; validate_data checks) -> blips (sfx row ids on the Voice bus; the blips cycle through the set), pitch (a pitch scale on top of the row's own timbre), rate_ms (the shortest gap between two blips; a blip sooner than that is dropped), jitter (each blip is pitched within +- this fraction, from a seeded generator), volume_db (added to the text box's blip_volume_db). default: the voice of an unknown speaker. vo: recorded lines, for later. A line's file is its compiled `voice` field when that is set, else `pattern` with {speaker} (the speaker, or the narrator identity of narration, else the `narrator` value) and {line_id}. When the file exists it plays on `bus` and, with suppress_blips, the line plays no blips; a missing file falls back to the blips. pace (M3-AUD-21): syllable (the default) blips once per syllable, on the box's mouth_flap opening (each vowel group, which the lip sync also follows), so blips rest through the reveal's punctuation pauses; letter blips once per blip the box counts (text_box.json blip_every_n_chars).
